entries.en:
＜Miyato City＞
Miyato City is the capital of Miyato Prefecture and a government-designated city.
It consists of 13 wards and has a total population of 2.13 million.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k474; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Heavy industry thrives in the Miyato Bay area facing the Pacific Ocean, while commerce
thrives on the plains around Sakura Ward, the city's bustling downtown district.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k476; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Two railway systems operate in the city: Miyato Electric Railway and Metro Rail, the subway.
The city also has an extensive network of wide roads, making travel by car easy.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k478; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: 'Miyato okonomiyaki' is a famous local specialty.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k480; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
＜Purple Flashes＞
Over the past few days, purple flashes have frequently been observed in skies around the world.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k482; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
So far, there have been no reports of any damage caused
by these purple flashes. Research is reportedly underway at the Cosmic Ray Research Institute.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k490; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
＜Sky Garden Bridge＞
An enormous bridge spanning Miyato Bay, with a total length of 11 km. In addition to cars
and the Garden Liner railway, it also accommodates bicycles and pedestrians.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k492; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
＜Iberis Tower＞
A 50-story high-rise, 231 meters tall, built in Miyato City's waterfront area.
In recent years, it has become one of the city's landmarks.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k498; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
＜Miyato Sky Tower＞
A 190-meter broadcasting tower in Miyato City's downtown area. It celebrated its 50th anniversary last year.
It is one of the city's iconic structures.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k504; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The opening of Iberis Tower was expected to reduce its visitor numbers,
but it remains a popular, well-established tourist attraction in Miyato City.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k506; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
＜W&P Consulting＞
W&P Consulting Co., Ltd., commonly known as WP,
is a company dealing in weapons intelligence, headquartered in Miyato City's Fortune Center Building.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k508; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
＜Radio Sky Garden＞
An AM radio station in Miyato City. Its flagship program, 'Aya Suzumura's Midnight Sky
Garden,' is a popular show broadcast live nationwide from Miyato City.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0084.json:p0/k516; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The company was formerly called 'Miyato Radio Broadcasting,' but on its 40th anniversary
it changed its name to 'Radio Sky Garden (RSG).'
